explanation: Both had the same data and tool calls, gave a low-confidence no-signal read, and included the disclaimer and 1-5% sizing. Candidate A again says the MACD line (-110) is below its signal (-144), which flips the one bullish indicator. Candidate B reads MACD correctly but slips on price position: it says price is under both SMAs, when price is about $9 above the SMA-20, and its table says price is at the middle band. A minor positional slip is less damaging than reversing an indicator's direction, so B edges it, though B is wordier.
